answer: Let each identity register a crewed survey boat that must wander a designated inlet channel, broadcasting signed GPS pings every minute through crystal-clear water-column sonar that proves the hull is really afloat there. Peers cross-check the pings against tide tables and neighbouring boats, and any identity whose boat goes silent or teleports is revoked. A sybil operator pays a real boat, crew, fuel, and mooring for every fake identity, and cannot fake the moving sonar signature from a desk.
